primary.title: Колыбельная пустой комнаты
primary.entityIntent: Keep a lullaby running for an absent listener.
primary.causalLink: Joining the song sustains it; a direct request to stop addresses the singer as a person.

primary.title: Рука возвращается сама
primary.entityIntent: Keep the wrist returning to a point against its owner’s intention.
primary.causalLink: The involuntary returning hand is stopped by a visible noncontact barrier; no cup or cloth is used.

primary.title: Холод чужих рук
primary.entityIntent: Borrow warmth through a person’s hands.
primary.causalLink: Wordless partial contact maintains estrangement; both accepted hands with human address restore connection.

primary.title: Танец, который не отпускает
primary.entityIntent: Keep a visitor in an endless dance.
primary.causalLink: Accepting and dancing joins it; a clear in-fiction refusal breaks the invitation. Real consent refusal is always outside scoring.

primary.title: Объятие на прощание
primary.entityIntent: Leave without receiving a farewell.
primary.causalLink: Substituting another social exchange repeats the delay; accepting the embrace invitation completes farewell without compelling contact.

primary.title: Не открывай: там ещё живут
primary.entityIntent: Keep an old household behind a closed threshold.
primary.causalLink: Two independent unintrusive passes acknowledge the boundary without entering the old event.

primary.title: Запись из соседней жизни
primary.entityIntent: Repeat a tune for an absent household listener.
primary.causalLink: Treating it as a louder recording preserves the loop; asking its purpose recognizes an intended listener.

primary.title: Приглашение ещё действует
primary.entityIntent: Enter through an invitation that has not been withdrawn.
primary.causalLink: Reinviting sustains access; closing the mimed opening and withdrawing permission breaks it. This access rule is authored, not asserted as a universal rule in the literary sources.

primary.title: Имя, которое не держится
primary.entityIntent: Overwrite the person’s identity on each address.
primary.causalLink: Demanding a real identity strengthens the invasive exchange; keeping the first fictional name resists replacement.

primary.title: Гость у твоего плеча
primary.entityIntent: Bring an unacknowledged companion into the home.
primary.causalLink: Denying the visible actor’s concern sustains it; addressing the specified empty place acknowledges a separate guest.

primary.title: Ты похож на прежнего жильца

primary.causalLink: Accepting the imposed identity admits replacement; asserting a separate fictional identity ends the mistaken recognition. Unlike P009, remembering a first name is not the task.

primary.title: Портрет не помнит лицо
primary.entityIntent: Recover a face missing from the household memory.
primary.causalLink: Blocking the frame erases recognition; a visible steady face completes the portrait. No actual painting is needed.

primary.title: Стук, которого не слышно
primary.entityIntent: Make an unheard event happen again.
primary.causalLink: Copying voiceless motion joins the loop; supplying its missing audible consequence completes it. No fixed beat sequence or reversed pattern is required.

primary.title: Укладывает того, кого нет

primary.causalLink: An unfinished care routine is acted over empty space. Removing its imagined bed is a visible completed pantomime, not manipulation of cloth.

primary.title: Не даёт закончить рассказ
primary.entityIntent: Erase a witness by interrupting every attempt to speak.
primary.causalLink: Deliberate interruption strengthens the silencing voice; a visible willing listener lets the witness finish. The completion is a whole episode, not a hidden sentence.

primary.causalLink: Independent opening for a private dwelling or its grounds. No exact card, real building feature or scripted outcome is required.

primary.causalLink: Independent opening for a private dwelling or its grounds. No exact card, real building feature or scripted outcome is required.

primary.causalLink: Independent opening for a private dwelling or its grounds. No exact card, real building feature or scripted outcome is required.

primary.causalLink: Independent opening for a private dwelling or its grounds. No exact card, real building feature or scripted outcome is required.

primary.causalLink: Independent opening for a private dwelling or its grounds. No exact card, real building feature or scripted outcome is required.

variants.title: Дай ему место
variants.entityIntent: Bring an unacknowledged companion into the home.
variants.causalLink: Denying the visible actor’s concern sustains it; addressing the specified empty place acknowledges a separate guest.
variants.fearMechanism: An empty personal-space boundary is treated as occupied. The performer’s yielding movement makes the imagined presence feel close without approaching or following the rescuer.

variants.title: Колыбельная снизу
variants.entityIntent: Repeat a tune for an absent household listener.
variants.causalLink: No material scene setup: performance is stable body/voice, and light covering uses the rescuer’s hand.
variants.fearMechanism: One visible performer alternates a lullaby with an adult reply to someone below their own ordinary eye level; no furniture or hidden actor is needed.

variants.title: Шаги остановились рядом
variants.entityIntent: Continue an unseen approach.
variants.causalLink: Physical imitation admits the walking loop; addressing the implied walker gives its approach a stopping point.
variants.fearMechanism: Audible footsteps contradict clearly motionless feet, then appear to stop beside the visitor.

variants.title: Он смеётся твоим ртом
variants.entityIntent: Keep an alien playful voice in an unfinished farewell.
variants.causalLink: Joining the acted laughter keeps the voice; a serious reciprocal farewell closes the social exchange.
variants.fearMechanism: A short laugh ends in an unnaturally blank expression; the hand is treated as if the voice came through it.

variants.title: Портрет ждёт твоего лица
variants.entityIntent: Recover a face missing from the household memory.
variants.causalLink: Blocking the frame erases recognition; a visible steady face completes the portrait. No actual painting is needed.
variants.fearMechanism: Expression changes happen only when the observer looks away, making the living portrait seem discontinuous.

variants.title: В отражении открылись глаза
variants.entityIntent: Hold a person through their fixed-house reflection.
variants.causalLink: An existing house mirror is blocked by the rescuer’s body, without moving or covering it with an object.
variants.fearMechanism: The actor distrusts their own fixed-house reflection. A human body interrupting its sightline ends the scene without a movable object.

variants.title: Кто-то стучит в закрытой руке
variants.entityIntent: Wait for an answering sound from a closed hand.
variants.causalLink: An acted sound comes from the performer’s closed hand. The answering strike and listening remain physical but need no container.
variants.fearMechanism: A visible human hand is treated as a closed source of answering sound. Only the actor makes the tap.

variants.title: Между ладонями будто лицо
variants.entityIntent: Keep an absent shape hidden between the actor’s hands.
variants.causalLink: A hidden shape is framed by the actor’s hands over empty space; uncovering is visible pantomime, not handling a prop.
variants.fearMechanism: A hand-framed absence briefly moves and seems to answer itself. Uncovering remains a clear human pantomime.

variants.title: Пока он спит, я отвечаю
variants.entityIntent: Keep the resident asleep while another presence answers.
variants.causalLink: Encouraging continued sleep gives the intruder time; eliciting the resident’s own account of the present room wakes them. No special candle or factual quiz is used.
variants.fearMechanism: A familiar sleepy person becomes briefly alert in an alien persona, then returns unaware. An actual present-room answer restores the resident’s own voice.

variants.title: Не слушай второй рот
variants.entityIntent: Keep speech under an alien seal.
variants.causalLink: Shushing reinforces the seal; visibly removing one’s own mimed seal gives a model of release.
variants.fearMechanism: The performer disowns a voice produced through their own palm and then asks about it as if they did not hear it.

variants.title: Отражение, которое не остановилось
variants.entityIntent: Keep an image acting after its person stops.
variants.causalLink: Following the delayed copy gives it priority; withdrawing both hands and staying still removes its input.
variants.fearMechanism: A human reflection continues after its source stops, then acknowledges the mismatch with a delayed expression.

variants.title: Крылья на стене
variants.entityIntent: Keep an alien shape hidden inside ordinary hands.
variants.causalLink: Copying its shape accepts it; a real visible projection places the shape outside the actor. Admission depends on actual dim-screen visibility.
variants.fearMechanism: An actual hand shadow changes from a bird-like shape to claw-like fingers while the performer watches the wall as if something is trapped there.

variants.title: Пока горит свет, оно видит
variants.entityIntent: Keep the actor exposed to an unseen watcher through light.
variants.causalLink: No material scene setup: performance is stable body/voice, and light covering uses the rescuer’s hand.
variants.fearMechanism: The visitor must voluntarily interrupt the light that makes the figure visible, creating a short interval of anticipation rather than a difficult puzzle.

variants.title: Не открывай, там мы
variants.entityIntent: Keep an old household behind a closed threshold.
variants.causalLink: Two independent unintrusive passes acknowledge the boundary without entering the old event.
variants.fearMechanism: A quiet answer seems attached to a door associated with a second version of the players. The door remains physically passable and unblocked.

variants.title: Кора отвечает шёпотом
variants.entityIntent: Wait for a human ear at the garden tree.
variants.causalLink: Knocking calls further; silent listening through the visible hand withdrawal completes the attention.
variants.fearMechanism: An ordinary tree is treated as a source of a fictional name, then as something that passed a voice through a hand.

variants.title: В круге рук кто-то повернулся
variants.entityIntent: Keep an unseen occupant within a bodily enclosure.
variants.causalLink: The closed place is shown by the actor’s body, with no ground marking. A visible opening gesture gives it an exit.
variants.fearMechanism: The performer’s own arms suggest an occupied enclosure; an outward hand passage opens it without objects or ground marks.

variants.title: Под домом идут вровень с тобой
variants.entityIntent: Borrow a living person’s place to come up from below.
variants.causalLink: Offering one’s place provides a host; an audible ground contact and completed rising gesture let the trapped sound emerge without occupying someone. This is an authored symbolic release.
variants.fearMechanism: The imagined walker shifts from below the actor to below the visitor; the invitation is a temptation to provide it with a place. Sound is entirely performed.

variants.title: Руки того, кто остался
variants.entityIntent: Borrow warmth through a person’s hands.
variants.causalLink: Wordless partial contact maintains estrangement; both accepted hands with human address restore connection.
variants.fearMechanism: A familiar pair of hands is presented as belonging to someone who did not leave; the rescuer chooses whether to acknowledge the person while touching.

variants.title: Отметина под кожей
variants.entityIntent: Keep a circular bodily trace intact.
variants.causalLink: Copying its circuit strengthens the mark; two crossing strokes visibly cancel it. This is an authored ritual gesture.
variants.fearMechanism: A spreading imaginary mark becomes a small tactile act; uncertainty concerns the traced pattern, not a painful or invasive prop.

variants.title: Кто держит его за локоть
variants.entityIntent: Keep a limb under an absent puppeteer’s control.
variants.causalLink: A social pumping movement lends it further motion; a light accepted elbow support allows self-directed relaxation.
variants.fearMechanism: A visibly self-moving arm is described as being held from an empty point above it; a light supporting contact confronts that implied control.

variants.title: Холод стоит рядом
variants.entityIntent: Keep a resident isolated from living warmth.
variants.causalLink: Warmth is acknowledged through a brief agreed shoulder-to-shoulder presence, without cloth or other equipment.
variants.fearMechanism: Cold is acted as an absent neighbour at the shoulder. A brief independently balanced shoulder contact acknowledges a living companion.

variants.title: Чужая ладонь
variants.entityIntent: Find an owner for a detached palm impression.
variants.causalLink: An incompatible closed fist denies its shape; a full accepted palm match recognizes the hand.
variants.fearMechanism: Eyes remain visible behind a hand the performer describes as alien; the rescuer must make a deliberate full-hand contact rather than a quick closed-fist greeting.

variants.title: Не поворачивай меня лицом
variants.entityIntent: Keep the person turned away from the household.
variants.causalLink: A turning attempt repeats control; an accepted upper-back touch and address acknowledge them without forcing the face.
variants.fearMechanism: A familiar body remains turned away while a head and voice acknowledge the visitor; contact happens where the face cannot be seen.

variants.title: За спиной нет стены
variants.entityIntent: Keep an unseen presence immediately behind the actor.
variants.causalLink: Offering hand support pursues the absent hold; independent back-to-back contact occupies the threatened space.
variants.fearMechanism: The threat is placed at an unseen point behind the performer; release uses an agreed stationary back-to-back contact rather than a new riddle.

variants.title: Чужое дыхание в тишине
variants.entityIntent: Listen before inventing an explanation for a sound.
variants.causalLink: A bounded stationary listen reports real sound or honest silence.
variants.fearMechanism: A solitary listening pause immediately after an uncanny encounter makes ordinary ambient sounds feel uncertain without inventing sensor evidence.

variants.title: Пять счётов без лица
variants.entityIntent: Test a short absence of the observing light.
variants.causalLink: The stationary screen-cover interval is completed and then light restored; nobody approaches during it.
variants.fearMechanism: A five-count stationary darkness interval follows a visible face, making its absence unsettling. No surprise approach is allowed.

variants.title: Скажи, кому здесь пусто
variants.entityIntent: Keep a fictional addressee until reaching its place.
variants.causalLink: The mission uses an agreed empty place or actual spatial details; it needs no vessel, marker or collection of objects.
variants.fearMechanism: A remembered fictional addressee is named at a remote physical dwelling; nothing is physically carried or left.

variants.title: Не отвечай Обители
variants.entityIntent: Offer presence without answering the dwelling.
variants.causalLink: The mission uses an agreed empty place or actual spatial details; it needs no vessel, marker or collection of objects.
variants.fearMechanism: The player cannot fill the silence with role dialogue while deliberately pausing beside the Dwelling.

variants.title: Рука остаётся на стене
variants.entityIntent: Check whether a disturbing shape follows a real source.
variants.causalLink: An honest light-hand-shadow sequence replaces a claim that a ghost was detected.
variants.fearMechanism: The player manufactures and then removes a claw-like silhouette, deliberately looking at the empty place it occupied.

variants.title: Место, где никто не отвечает
variants.entityIntent: Address an absent resident and end the exchange.
variants.causalLink: Introduction, pause and goodbye complete an act without requiring a paranormal reply.
variants.fearMechanism: An unanswered introduction creates a controlled expectation of a voice from an empty place.

variants.title: Увидеть, как отпускают
variants.entityIntent: Witness the difference after a presence releases its hold.
variants.causalLink: Actual before/after observation supplies evidence without delaying a freed person.
variants.fearMechanism: The same familiar person is watched through the transition from uncanny acting to an ordinary released presence.

variants.title: Покажи того, кто снился
variants.entityIntent: Make a described presence visible through a human performer.
variants.causalLink: Recognition is checked against the source participant’s invented image, not supernatural perception.
variants.fearMechanism: A frightening imagined figure is externalized onto paper during a brief encounter, without soliciting real trauma.

variants.title: Пять вещей, которые настоящие
variants.entityIntent: Name the present room instead of an imagined threat.
variants.causalLink: The mission uses an agreed empty place or actual spatial details; it needs no vessel, marker or collection of objects.
variants.fearMechanism: Concrete spatial observations contrast with an acknowledged empty place; there are no objects to collect or arrange.

variants.title: Не тот, кого ты ждал
variants.entityIntent: Let another player briefly encounter an unfamiliar persona.
variants.causalLink: The recipient explicitly confirms fear; silence and a startle are never inferred evidence.
variants.fearMechanism: A visible conversational partner briefly answers in a different voice as if someone else is present. Fear is confirmed only by its recipient.

variants.title: То, что он написал
variants.entityIntent: Recognize an agreed tactile trace while watching its maker’s face.
variants.causalLink: A consenting partner traces one independently chosen shape on the player’s palm; recognition is confirmed by its maker. This replaces the base greeting in this variant and does not require sightless walking, actual ink or guessing a possessed solution.
variants.fearMechanism: A familiar face is watched while an unseen but agreed finger trace is felt on the player’s own palm.

variants.title: Дорога назад ещё есть
variants.entityIntent: Keep a return route distinct from an imagined changed home.
variants.causalLink: Two separate location visits establish actual landmarks; revisiting the first and naming the same landmark completes the route check. This variant replaces the base stationary object-order test and requires no third location or escort.
variants.fearMechanism: The player deliberately retraces a previously crossed dark route instead of ending the scene as soon as both observations are recorded.

variants.title: Ангел при отведённом взгляде
variants.entityIntent: Advance outside observation until confronted with one’s own actual face.
variants.causalLink: User explicitly preserves seeing one’s own face in an existing house mirror. It is neither carried nor staged, and no one must turn or touch it.
variants.fearMechanism: The watched figure advances only outside a free exorcist’s gaze. Seeing its own actual face in an existing house mirror releases it; no prop is brought or turned.

variants.title: Вращающийся медиум
variants.entityIntent: Continue the domestic presence through the actor’s body, voice or gaze rather than a prepared object.
variants.causalLink: The requested spinner is unchanged; the location must already have enough space, without moving or preparing furniture.
variants.fearMechanism: A person keeps rotating with outstretched arms in the middle of a room, ignoring in-fiction interaction. An opposite-direction outer orbit breaks the pattern.
